methodology: Verify current 2026/27 squad membership before evaluating penalty evidence; exclude expired contracts, completed transfers and rumours.
Prioritize official hierarchy statements and regular-time penalties where relevant candidates were simultaneously available.
Use 2026 preseason and 2025/26 competitive regular-time attempts before set-piece role or career penalty logs.
Use career records only as fallback evidence for unresolved backups.
Exclude penalty-shootout kicks from regular-time hierarchy decisions.
Treat low-confidence backups and open-window squads as provisional until a current competitive event resolves precedence.
